title: Prototype SMP
description: An SMP that's always just a prototype! 一个永远是原型的生存+小游戏服务器！
body:
Prototype SMP is a Chinese SMP and minigames server, now open to players around the world! Even though the name is "prototype", it's not actually a prototype, and we guarantee your precious progress will never be cleared!

English support might not be complete in the server. Some players in the server are Chinese and doesn't speak english well, if you need any help with language problems, you can join our Discord to reach for help.

Basic server information:
- Keep inventory is on
- Simple Voice Chat is installed
- Has both survival and KitBattle PvP games

原型机SMP是一个生存+小游戏服务器，现在正在全球范围内招揽玩家。

服务器基础信息：
- 死亡不掉落
- 有Simple Voice Chat（简单的语音通话）模组
- 有原版生存和职业战争玩法
